teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, hundred, price, cost, dollar, euro, pound, cent, cheap, expensive, buy, pay

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, hundred, price, cost, dollar, euro, pound, cent, cheap, expensive, buy, pay
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How much is this? (asking price of singular item)
• How much are these? (asking price of plural items)
• It's twenty dollars (stating singular price)
• They are fifty euros (stating plural price)
• That's cheap / expensive (expressing opinion on price)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Aim
teacherNotes.content: Stress distinction: 'thir-teen /θɜːˈtiːn/ vs 'thir-ty /ˈθɜː.ti/, 'for-teen vs 'for-ty. Currency symbols pronunciation ($20 = twenty dollars).

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Stress distinction: 'thir-teen /θɜːˈtiːn/ vs 'thir-ty /ˈθɜː.ti/, 'for-teen vs 'for-ty. Currency symbols pronunciation ($20 = twenty dollars).

teacherNotes.title: Function-First Grammar Rule
teacherNotes.content: Questions with 'How much is...?' (singular) / 'How much are...?' (plural). Plural currency nouns (dollars, euros, pounds).

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Questions with 'How much is...?' (singular) / 'How much are...?' (plural). Plural currency nouns (dollars, euros, pounds).
Examples:

• How much is this book?
• It is 15 pounds.
• How much are these pens?
• They are 5 dollars.
• That is 100 euros.
Reading Dialogue & Script:

Script using target language:
Person A: How much is this?
Person B: How much are these?
Listening Comprehension Prompt: Listen to the prompt and confirm understanding.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Pair roleplay, information gap, and personalized speaking task.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:

Short Writing Task (~10%): Write 3-4 sentences in your notebook applying target chunks.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60 min Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up Price Guessing; 10-25m Tens Numbers 20-100 & Currency Vocab; 25-40m 'How much...' Grammar; 40-55m Flea Market Shopping Roleplay; 55-60m Cool-down.

• 90 min Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-25m Pronunciation -teen vs -ty; 25-45m Grammar Drills; 45-65m Store Auction Game; 65-85m Receipt Reading & Math; 85-90m Summary.

• 120 min Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Number Phonetics & Dictation; 40-70m Grammar System; 70-100m Department Store Roleplay; 100-115m Shopping List Writing; 115-120m Summary.
